core_concept: The CSS Cascade is a mechanism that determines which CSS rules apply to an HTML element when multiple rules could potentially be applied. It operates based on a prioritized order of factors, including specificity, inheritance, and source order.  The final rule applied is determined by the interaction of these factors, ensuring a consistent and predictable styling outcome across web pages.
technical_breakdown: The CSS Cascade resolves conflicts between CSS rules.
Specificity determines which rule takes precedence when multiple rules target the same element.
Inheritance allows properties to be passed down from parent elements to child elements.
